# HypeMuzik

> HypeMuzik is a free music player and equalizer for Android, iOS, macOS,
> Windows and Linux: no ads, no paywall, no sign-up. It is built around a
> 31-band graphic equalizer and a 12-stage DSP chain, with phone-to-desktop
> audio streaming. An optional pay-what-you-want Supporter pack funds
> development; every feature stays free for everyone.

HypeMuzik plays your own music — local files, plus Google Drive and Dropbox
libraries — and runs the same sound engine on every platform. On macOS the
desktop app can also process system-wide audio (every app's sound).

## Product
- [Home](https://hypemuzik.com/): features, the signal chain, FAQ and downloads.
- [Free system-wide equalizer for Mac](https://hypemuzik.com/mac-equalizer): EQ every app's audio on macOS 14.4+, no driver to install.
- [AutoEq headphone profiles](https://hypemuzik.com/autoeq): apply your headphone model's AutoEq correction on phone and desktop.
- [Free vocal remover and karaoke](https://hypemuzik.com/vocal-remover): on-device stem separation into vocals, drums and instruments, live while a song plays.
- [Free music player for Linux](https://hypemuzik.com/linux-music-player): 31-band equalizer and synced lyrics on Linux.
- [Desktop releases](https://github.com/Lw-Muzik/hype-dsp/releases/latest): macOS (universal .dmg, Apple Silicon + Intel), Windows (.exe/.msi), Linux (AppImage/.deb/.rpm).
- [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hypemuzik-dsp/id6760889647)
- [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=x.a.zix)
- [Hype Connect web remote](https://play.hypemuzik.com): control HypeMuzik on your phone or desktop from any browser.
- [Supporter pack](https://hypemuzik.com/support): optional, pay what you want; adds a Supporter badge.

## Key facts
- Price: free on every platform. No ads, no paywall, no sign-up.
- 31-band graphic equalizer at ISO third-octave centres (20 Hz – 20 kHz).
- 12-stage DSP chain, in order: headphone correction, graphic EQ, bass boost,
  spatializer, 3D surround, room reverb, convolution IR, multiband compander,
  tube saturation, script processor, makeup gain, brickwall limiter.
- AutoEq headphone correction: 3,938 headphone profiles on the desktop, more
  than 6,000 on the phone (from the AutoEq project by Jaakko Pasanen).
- Vocal remover / karaoke: on-device stem separation (vocals, drums,
  instruments) while a song plays; audio never leaves the device.
- Synced, karaoke-style lyrics, visualisers, acoustic fingerprint identify,
  gapless playback, crossfade and ReplayGain.
- Phone Link streams a phone's library through the desktop's DSP chain over the
  local network, with no cloud intermediary.
- Hype Connect pairs a phone, a desktop and any web browser with a 6-digit code
  or QR — no sign-up. Pick the device that plays, then search, queue, skip,
  follow lyrics and watch the visualiser from any of them. The web remote at
  https://play.hypemuzik.com never plays audio itself; one device plays at a
  time and pressing play on another takes over.
